Name: star360days
Author: StevenArmstrong765676
Description:
star360days – 360-Day Full Year

About This Mod

Have you ever felt that a year in Stardew Valley is just too short? Spring, summer, fall, and winter each last only 28 days – before you know it, a whole year has flown by. Crops are barely planted before the season changes, festivals come one after another too quickly, and you never get a chance to truly soak in each season's atmosphere before winter arrives.

star360days extends the game's year from the original 112 days to 360 days. Each season now consists of 3 months, with 30 days per month. Now you can truly "live" in Stardew Valley instead of being rushed by the clock.

Original: 4 seasons x 28 days = 112 days/year
This mod: 4 seasons x 3 months x 30 days = 360 days/year

Festivals and Events Redistributed

To make the new calendar system fit naturally into the game, all festivals, events, and NPC birthdays have been evenly redistributed across the new date system. You won't miss a single festival, nor will you encounter events that belong to a different season – everything has been carefully remapped to the new 360-day calendar.

A More Relaxed Pace – But Crop Growth Stays the Same

- Each season now lasts 90 full days, giving you plenty of time to plan your farm, explore the mines, and build deep friendships with every villager.

- Important: star360days only changes the number of days in the calendar; it does not alter any time-based game logic such as crop growth, regrowth intervals, animal maturation, or artisan machine processing times.
  For example, a parsnip that originally takes 4 days to mature will still take 4 days. A blueberry bush that produces every 3 days will still produce every 3 days.
  The difference is that, because each season is longer, you can grow more crop cycles within the same season without worrying about your plants withering at the end of the season (cross-season crop rules remain the same as vanilla).

- You can experiment with more diverse farming strategies and farm layouts without feeling pressured by the ticking calendar.

Vanilla-Aligned Game Experience

Apart from the extended calendar, the core gameplay, story, quest progression, and all other mechanics remain unchanged. You simply enjoy the same Stardew Valley experience over more days.

Installation

1. Make sure you have SMAPI (Stardew Valley mod loader) installed.
2. Extract the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Compatibility & Requirements

- Game version: Stardew Valley 1.6+
- Required mod: SMAPI
- Compatibility: This mod modifies the game's calendar system. It may conflict with other mods that also alter dates, seasons, or the calendar. It is recommended to back up your saves before using.
- Save compatibility: A new save is strongly recommended for the full experience. Using this mod on an existing save may cause date mismatches – please back up your save files beforehand.

FAQ

Q: Will festivals and birthdays still happen correctly?
A: Yes. All festivals, events, and NPC birthdays have been evenly redistributed according to the new 360-day calendar, so you won't miss anything.

Q: Does this affect crop growth times?
A: No. All time-based mechanics – crop growth, regrowth, animal growth, machine processing, etc. – retain their original values. The only change is the total number of days per season.

Q: Will this affect game story or quests?
A: No. The core story, quest triggers, and progression remain exactly as in vanilla. You just experience them over a longer timeline.

Q: Can I uninstall this mod mid-game?
A: It is not recommended. Removing it may corrupt your save file's date data. Always back up your save before installing.

Disclaimer

This mod makes deep changes to the game's core calendar system. Although tested, unforeseen issues may still occur. Please back up your save files before using.

Credits

- Thanks to the SMAPI team for making the Stardew Valley modding ecosystem possible.
- Thanks to all playtesters who provided valuable feedback.

Changelog

v1.0.0
- Initial release
- Extended the year to 360 days (3 months per season, 30 days per month)
- Redistributed all festivals, events, and NPC birthdays evenly across the new calendar
- Clarified that crop growth and other time-based mechanics are unchanged

If you enjoy this mod, please endorse it! Feel free to leave feedback and suggestions in the comments.
